name: travel
description: Flight & train ticket search with price/time comparison (Amadeus live offers, Brave web fallback).

tools.name: travel
tools.description: Search flight or train tickets and compare prices and times. action=search: fetch offers for a route+date, rank them (price, duration, stops) and return a top-N table with cheapest/fastest highlights. action=rerank: re-sort the last search by price/duration/balance. Requires origin/destination/date (YYYY-MM-DD). Live offers need Amadeus keys in the travel config section; without them it falls back to indicative web results.

action.description: search = fetch offers for a route+date; rerank = re-sort the last search

origin.description: Departure airport IATA code for flights (e.g. VIE) or city name for trains

destination.description: Arrival airport IATA code for flights or city name for trains

return_date.description: Optional return date YYYY-MM-DD (second search is made automatically)

top.description: How many ranked results to show, default 5
